Max hopes to visit Chengdu one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the reading room by bike. Max drinks milk after doing sports. Also, my classmate lent me a pen.
Max learned a lot about art. Last Saturday, Max and Tom went to the reading room. Max is reading a book about art. Ceramics is a popular night class.
Max is going to travel to Chengdu in November. They took many photos at the science lab. Tom is interested in cooking. Swimming is my favourite activity.
Life is full of small surprises. Max wrote about the day in the diary. Max thinks art is interesting but a little difficult.
